tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Word Order and Conjunctions

questions.question: Q: Rewrite with correct word order: Ich denke (dass / Deutsch / wichtig / sein). Ich bleibe zu Hause (weil / ich / krank / sein).
questions.correctAnswer: Ich denke, dass Deutsch wichtig ist. Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil ich krank bin. (Verb goes to the END after dass and weil.)

questions.question: Q: Rewrite starting with the subordinate clause: Ich gehe nicht aus, weil das Wetter schlecht ist. → Weil...
questions.correctAnswer: Weil das Wetter schlecht ist, gehe ich nicht aus. (Subordinate clause first = position 1; main clause verb must be in position 2 = gehe ich, NOT ich gehe.)

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Word Order and Conjunctions

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about main clause word order; subordinate clauses (verb to end); coordinating vs subordinating conjunctions; dass, weil, wenn, obwohl. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, modal verbs, separable verbs); show precise grammar (cases, word order, adjective endings); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge about DACH countries; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (außerdem, jedoch, trotzdem, zusammenfassend). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
